subject: English
passage: According to historian James N. Gregory, African American workers played a vital role in advancing workplace safety during the Korean War era. At that time, steel manufacturing companies signed contracts to provide the United States military with essential materials. Higher production demands gave workers increased leverage in negotiations with management, many of whom were African American laborers: workers demanded improved safety protocols and hazard pay, and management, eager to meet contract deadlines, agreed to these terms. Consequently, workplace safety advocacy became a vehicle for African American workers to exercise their collective power.
prompt: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined portion in the text as a whole?

choices.A: It elaborates on a claim about labor relations in a particular industry made earlier in the text.
choices.B: It offers an example of a trend in the Korean War–era economy discussed earlier in the text.
choices.C: It notes a possible exception to the historical narrative of workplace advocacy sketched earlier in the text.
choices.D: It provides further details about the backgrounds of the workers discussed earlier in the text.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer because it best describes how the underlined portion functions in the text as a whole. The text says that the higher production demands of steel manufacturing companies during the Korean War era enabled workers to gain increased leverage in negotiations with management. The underlined portion presents an example of this increased leverage: workers demanded improved safety protocols and hazard pay, and management agreed because they were under pressure to meet contract deadlines. Thus, the underlined portion of the text elaborates on a claim about labor relations in a particular industry (steel manufacturing) made earlier in the text.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because the underlined portion supports the historical narrative of workplace advocacy in steel manufacturing that is sketched in the text, instead of noting an exception to that narrative.
